tracks.name: TOAST v1 · LIBERO training-data scale paper table
tracks.split: Spatial / Object / Goal / Long; aggregate reported across suites
tracks.protocol: For every training-data fraction, evaluation is fixed: 500 rollouts per suite (50/task), 2,000 rollouts per seed, three independently trained seeds; columns differ only in policy training-data fraction.
tracks.trainingRegime: PaliGemma-3B autoregressive VLA; identical subsets/settings per fraction across tokenizer methods; columns 1/1..1/16 are training-data fractions, not distinct evaluation settings.

results.trainingData: Columns are LIBERO policy-training fractions 1/1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16; identical subsets are used across methods within a fraction.
results.evaluationNotes: Evaluation remains 500 rollouts/suite, 2,000/seed and three independently trained seeds for every fraction. Training fraction is result metadata, not a new evaluation setting.
